housing.summary: Gold Coast is a popular coastal city in QLD. A 1-bedroom apartment in the city centre (Surfers Paradise area) typically rents for approximately AUD 450–550 per week. Queensland's Residential Tenancies Act caps the bond at 4 weeks rent. Primary rental portals are realestate.com.au and domain.com.au.

banking.summary: To open a bank account in Australia, new arrivals typically need a valid passport, proof of Australian address, and a Tax File Number (TFN). CommBank allows account opening up to 14 days before arrival. ANZ and NAB also serve new residents.
required_docs: Valid passport (original required for in-branch ID verification within 20 days)

schools.summary: The Gold Coast has international and IB schools. The national school directory myschool.edu.au lists all QLD schools in the Gold Coast area. State schools are under the Queensland Department of Education.

legal_admin.summary: Visa holders in Australia must notify the Department of Home Affairs of any address changes. New residents should register with myGov (my.gov.au) to link ATO, Medicare, and Centrelink services.
legal_admin.registration_step: Register with myGov; notify Home Affairs of address changes

tax_finance.summary: All workers and income earners in Australia require a Tax File Number (TFN) from the Australian Taxation Office (ATO). Apply online for free at ato.gov.au.

transport.summary: Gold Coast public transport is operated by Translink (Queensland Government) using the go card or contactless payments. As of 2024, Queensland introduced a 50-cent flat fare across all Translink services network-wide. The Gold Coast Light Rail (G:link) is included in the Translink network. Overseas licence holders in QLD must convert to a Queensland licence via TMR upon taking up residency. Medicare registration via Services Australia.
transport.network_name: Translink / G:link Gold Coast Light Rail
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Queensland residents must convert their overseas licence to a Queensland licence via Department of Transport and Main Roads (TMR). Required upon becoming a QLD resident.
transport.healthcare_registration: Eligible visa holders enrol in Medicare at Services Australia offices or online via servicesaustralia.gov.au/medicare.
